_nguon: Qiong Tong Bao Jian (compiled by Yu Chuntai, Qing dynasty; based on Lan Jiang Wang) — a summary table of the Useful God by the climate-adjusting method for 10 Day Master stems × 12 months, following the widely circulated edition. The order of the stems is the order of priority. Not yet checked against the original text section by section.
